ios.desc:
Ever lost part of your security deposit to mysterious charges? DepositGenie is your secret weapon to protect your deposit and keep every dollar you deserve. Document your rental from move-in to move-out and be ready to dispute unfair charges with confidence
.
Never lose money to unfair deductions again - DepositGenie helps you:

- Capture Every Detail: Take timestamped photos and videos of each room and item. Create a complete move-in record (with notes and GPS tags) so you have irrefutable proof of your apartment’s condition
.
- Spot Issues with AI: Let our AI compare move-in vs. move-out photos to flag potential damage or changes. Quickly identify what a landlord might charge for, before they do, and address it proactively.

- Generate Dispute-Ready Evidence – Instantly compile your photos, videos, and notes into a professional PDF report. All files are hashed for authenticity, giving you a solid evidence bundle for disputes or small claims court
.
- Send Formal Letters in Minutes: Draft polite, legally-sound dispute letters or demand letters with one tap. Use our built-in templates (written with tenant-law guidelines) to respond to landlords and get your deposit back faster
.
- Never Miss a Deadline: Stay on top of critical dates. Get automatic reminders for inspection walk-throughs, move-out notices, and your state’s deadline for security deposit returns. No more missing the window to claim your money.

- Built for Renters, by Renters: Unlike generic “inspection” apps made for landlords, DepositGenie is designed solely for tenants. Our friendly approach guides you step-by-step, so you know your rights and have the tools to enforce them. The interface is simple enough for a first-time renter, yet robust enough for seasoned tenants who’ve been burned before.

- Peace of Mind on Move-Out Day: When it’s time to return the keys, you won’t be biting your nails. Every photo, form, and file you need is in your pocket. DepositGenie users report walking away with 100% of their deposit in hand – and a big smile.

Download DepositGenie for free today and join thousands of renters who’ve reclaimed their security deposits. Don’t let your landlord have the last word, arm yourself with DepositGenie and move with confidence!

quotes.text:
Hey everyone! I’m a solo founder building a tool I wish I’d had years ago.

If you’ve ever rented a place, you’ve probably worried about your security deposit. You take move-in photos, cross your fingers at move-out, and hope the landlord doesn’t decide the scuff on the wall is “$400 worth of damage.” I’ve been there..and it sucks.

That’s why I built DepositGenie: Deposit Armor — an iOS app that helps renters actually keep their deposits by making documentation dead simple.

What it does:
- Organize your move-in and move-out photos by room, with timestamps and notes.

- AI highlights possible deductions, like comparing before/after shots and flagging what looks new or changed.

- Export everything into a clean, court-ready report if you need to dispute charges.

- Track key deadlines so you don’t miss refund windows or inspection dates.

Basically, it’s a pocket-sized armor kit for renters.

Why now:

More people are renting than ever, and most of us don’t know what to do when deductions happen.

You don’t need a lawyer, you just need organized proof. DepositGenie gives you that.

Tech & business side:

I built it with Flutter + Firebase, designed everything myself, and launched it on a shoestring.

The app is free to try with optional in-app upgrades for full features.

I’m not a big company, just one person trying to fix a tiny but expensive pain point.

Looking for feedback:

I’d love your honest thoughts on:
- Whether this scratches a real itch you’ve had
- What would …
